meta.source: A.T. trail assessments, 2004-2008 and 2009-2013 (at_deficiencies_2004_2008, at_deficiencies_2009_2013), provided by APPA
meta.method: Treadway problems recorded in each cell, both cycles. DF_REL = recorded problems / expected, where expected = miles of trail in the cell x its trail club section's rate of recorded problems per mile, so 1 = the section average and differences in how sections recorded drop out.
meta.segments: segs: treadway problems within 50 m of each trail segment in data/trail_segments.json (by seg_id; 96% of records lie within 50 m, median 5 m)
